name: Immich
summary: High performance self-hosted photo and video backup solution.

catalog.description: Immich is a self-hosted photo and video management server with automatic backup from mobile devices, facial recognition, object detection, and album organization.

features.title: Automatic mobile backup
features.body: Backup photos and videos automatically from your phone using the official Immich mobile app.

features.title: Facial recognition
features.body: Automatically organize photos by people using on-device machine learning.

features.title: Smart search
features.body: Search photos by objects, locations, dates, and people.

complexity.label: Heavy application
complexity.description: Immich runs multiple services including a database, cache, and machine learning worker. Requires significant CPU and memory.

resourceHint.label: High resources
resourceHint.description: This package requires minimum 4GB RAM and CPU with AVX2 support for optimal machine learning performance.

privacy.summary: All photos, metadata, and machine learning models stay fully on your MOS server.
notes: Photo and video library data is stored in package-owned volumes.
Only the Immich web service is exposed through HTTPS; database, cache, and machine learning services remain internal.
Machine learning processing runs entirely locally on your server.

setupGuide.title: First run setup
setupGuide.body: Immich will automatically prepare the database on first startup. This may take several minutes.

setupGuide.title: Create admin account
setupGuide.body: After Immich finishes starting, open the application and create your first admin user account directly in the Immich web interface.

setupGuide.title: Backup important
setupGuide.body: Your photo library is stored in the Immich package volume. Ensure you run regular MOS backups before uploading large amounts of data.

setupGuide.title: Install mobile app
setupGuide.body: Download the official Immich mobile app from App Store or Google Play to enable automatic photo backup from your device.
